title: SEC2: pool_release holds mutex over open() syscall
description: In crypto2dev_pool_release() (line 424), open(CRYPTO2DEV_PATH, ...) is called while the pool mutex is held. open() is a blocking syscall that can take O(ms) depending on driver state. All threads waiting for a pool slot are blocked for the entire duration. Fix: clear in_use and release the lock first, then open() the fresh fd and re-acquire the lock to write it back. Alternatively, pre-open a replacement fd before entering the critical section.
